portal_description:
The Pacemaker cluster resource manager is a collection of technologies working together to maintain data integrity and application availability in the event of failures.

Bug Fix(es):

* Fix a bug where if the attribute daemon that won the writer election is on a node that is shutting down, the cluster can hang on shutdown. (JIRA:RHEL-14052)
